channel.title: Pysano Updates
channel.description: Stable and beta updates for Pysano.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.37
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0-beta.37
Experimental beta: not notarized by Apple.
- Speak or type commands for selected text and screenshots. Enter sends a command; Shift+Enter starts a new line. The native editor restores keyboard focus when reopened and after a response. - Continue with a temporary chat about the original material and previous answers, using the keyboard or a spoken follow-up. Chats stay on the originally chosen model and are cleared when closed or when the Mac session locks. - Choose a local or cloud model explicitly for screenshot questions and quick double-⌘C translation. Model selectors clearly label Local and Cloud processing. Screenshot translation follows the requested target language. - Added local image support for Gemma 4 E4B and downloadable Qwen3.5 9B and 27B text/image models, with memory guidance and verified weights. Remove text models with their vision components, or remove a vision component independently. - Preview the exact captured screen area from its thumbnail in the answer. Capture files are removed after use; old capture leftovers are cleaned on launch. An optional setting opens area capture immediately when a command finds no selected text. - Local text commands and follow-ups count the full prompt with the selected model's tokenizer and choose an 8K, 16K or 32K working context, reserving room for the answer. The app does not silently truncate the source or conversation history. - Start a new command immediately after a failure. Retry command reuses an already recognized instruction instead of transcribing it again. - Reorganized settings into Dictation, Commands, Models, Appearance, Connection and Updates, with focused tabs. Unified graphite/cyan tabs, buttons, selectors and checkboxes across settings, notes and command windows. Increased text sizes, contrast and line spacing for easier reading. - Updated the cloud privacy disclosure to cover screenshot processing. Gemini features require acknowledging the updated disclosure once. Local image and text processing remain on this Mac; voice recognition follows the selected speech model.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.36
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0-beta.36
Experimental beta: not notarized by Apple.
- Ask questions about a selected screen area using local Qwen3.5 4B. Start from the Pysano menu or the freeform voice-command shortcut when no text is selected. Screenshot questions require local speech recognition and the optional 672 MB vision component. The result preview displays your recognized question above the answer. - Optionally proofread ordinary dictation with Qwen, Gemma, or Lapa before insertion. Choose the local model under Dictation. If proofreading fails, times out, changes digits, or returns an invalid result, Pysano uses the original recognized text.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.35
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0-beta.35
Experimental beta: not notarized by Apple.
- Choose Gemini, Qwen, Gemma, or Lapa for saved and freeform voice actions. Translate, summarize, rewrite, or ask a question about selected text. Local processing uses the same model downloads as Meeting notes. Choose a local dictation model as well to keep the voice instruction on the Mac. - Dictation sound options include macOS System, Typewriter, Gaming Keyboard, Toggle Switch, Wood Tap, Mellow Tap, and Water Drop. Preview the start and stop cues separately in Dictation settings.

# Pysano 0.7.1
- The **Repair Key Access** action now rebuilds the legacy Keychain item's ACL once for Pysano's stable code signature, preventing an unlock prompt on every launch. - The API key remains in Keychain; there are no automatic system prompts and the key is never saved to project files. - Added four feedback sound sets: Liquid, Soft Chime, Pulse, and macOS System. - Liquid is the new default short cue. Every option can be previewed in Settings without starting a recording, and sound feedback can still be disabled completely.

# Pysano 0.7.0
- Made the dictation indicator smaller and moved its default position to the top so it does not cover the input field. - Added top, bottom, left, and right indicator placement options. - The completion message can be hidden or displayed for 0.5, 1, 2, or 4 seconds; the default is 1 second. - Added native macOS sounds at recording start and completion, with a separate sound toggle.

# Pysano 0.6.2
- Added a focused-node fallback for ChatGPT, Codex, and other Chromium/Electron/WebKit editors that expose `AXGroup` or `AXWebArea` instead of a standard text AX role. - Before insertion, Pysano revalidates the original app, window, and Accessibility node; password and secure containers remain blocked. - A missing Accessibility permission is no longer masked by an unknown text-field message. - After a failed attempt, the menu offers sanitized focus diagnostics that exclude field text, selection, keystrokes, and clipboard contents.
